facts.fact: Guinea's HAC revoked France 24's national broadcasting authorisation and withdrew its correspondents' press accreditations with immediate effect, citing the channel's refusal to withdraw incriminated remarks, an 'offence' to President Doumbouya.
The HAC ordered the telecoms regulator ARPT to block without delay all France 24 digital access points (websites, streaming feeds, apps) in Guinea, and Canal+ Guinée to cut the channel's signal.
